meta.name: frame-logo-outro
meta.description: Logo 分块组装入场 + glow bloom + tagline 揭示, 适合视频片尾 / 品牌闭幕

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频添加品牌闭幕动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频结尾制作品牌动画
copy.tagline_en: Add brand closing animation to videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create brand animation for video endings

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按你的品牌名和 tagline 生成一个 1920×1080 的单文件 HTML 片尾帧:logo 由 4-8 个几何块滑入拼装,随后加 glow bloom 和 shimmer,品牌名、tagline、底部 CTA 依次浮现,动画播完即定格不循环。
howto.when: 当你要做视频片尾或品牌闭幕帧时接管;若你没给品牌名和 tagline,它就退回用 "HTML Anything" / "Anything → beautiful HTML"。

say.text: 做一个品牌片尾帧,品牌名 XX,tagline YY

say.note: 改用暖琥珀 accent,不与其他配色混用

say.text: 用 Bone & Ink 配色,glow 改成阴影

howto.what_en: Generates a single-file 1920×1080 HTML brand end card: a logo of 4–8 geometric blocks slides in and assembles, then gets glow bloom and shimmer; brand name, tagline and CTA row follow. The animation freezes at the end, no loop.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a video end card or brand closing frame; it builds the outro from your brand name and tagline, falling back to "HTML Anything" when none is given.

say_en.text: Make a brand end card: name XX, tagline YY
Switch the palette to Solar Amber
say_en.note: Uses the warm amber accent only

say_en.text: Use Bone & Ink, glow as shadow
